name: demo-launcher
description: Create booth demo repos from repo-setup-scripts, watch progress, and jump into the repo, PRs, or Copilot Chat.

demoLauncher.repoPath.markdownDescription: Path to your `repo-setup-scripts` checkout. Leave empty to use an open workspace folder that is that repo, or the checkout the installer recorded.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_open
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open the Demo Launcher panel in VS Code, optionally preselecting a demo template by key.

template.description: Optional template key to preselect (see demoLauncher_listTemplates).

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_listTemplates
languageModelTools.userDescription: List booth demo templates from config.json.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the booth demo templates defined in repo-setup-scripts' config.json, with their keys, descriptions, and whether they have a seed prompt.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_launch
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create a booth demo repo in the background.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create a booth demo repo in the background by running create-repo non-interactively for a template key. Opens the Demo Launcher panel to show progress and returns the run (id, status, links). Poll with demoLauncher_getRun; runs take a few minutes.

owner.description: Account or org to create the repo in.

openBrowser.description: Let the script open browser tabs.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_getRun
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get status, links, and log of a demo run.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get status, links (repo, PRs, issues, Pages, clone path, Copilot review state), and the log of a demo run. Defaults to the latest run.

runId.description: Run id; defaults to the latest run.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_listRuns
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List recent demo runs with their status and links.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_cancel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Stop an in-progress demo run. Defaults to the latest run.

runId.description: Run id; defaults to the latest run.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_runSeedPrompt
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a demo's clone in a new window and run its seed prompt in Copilot Chat.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: For demos with a seed prompt and a local clone: open the clone in a new VS Code window and run the seed prompt there in Copilot Chat agent mode. Defaults to the latest run.

runId.description: Run id; defaults to the latest run.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_cleanupPreview
languageModelTools.userDescription: List demo-generated repos that cleanup would delete.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List repos with the demo-generated topic older than the cutoff that cleanup would delete. Nothing is deleted. Show the list to the user before calling demoLauncher_cleanupDelete.

owner.description: Account or org; defaults to the logged-in account.

languageModelTools.name: demoLauncher_cleanupDelete
languageModelTools.userDescription: Delete repos from the current cleanup preview.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Delete repos from the current cleanup preview (run demoLauncher_cleanupPreview first). Only call after the user confirmed the list. VS Code also asks the user to confirm.

repos.description: owner/name repos from the preview; defaults to all of them.

removeClones.description: Also delete matching local clones in ~/repos.
